tools.name: data_parse_csv_to_json
tools.description:
Use this when you need to convert CSV data to a JSON array. Returns parsed data with auto-detected settings in JSON.

Returns: 1. data (array of objects with column names as keys) 2. rowCount 3. columnCount 4. detectedDelimiter 5. headers array.

Example output: {"data":[{"name":"Alice","age":"30","
